rationale: The agent verified the user correctly (name + zip matched a single account), checked the latest order via tools, and reported accurate order details and status. It also appropriately declined a cross-category exchange per stated store rules and suggested a return after delivery. However, it did not complete the user’s requested exchange, and more importantly, it promised to “remind you to check back once your order is delivered” without using any tool to set or track such a reminder. That constitutes an unsupported/fabricated action. Therefore, the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
